title: 介系詞
point: 介系詞題先看後面接的是時間點還是時間長度，再看動作是完成、持續，還是從過去延續到現在。
formula: 主詞 + 動詞 + 受詞 + within / by / since + 時間

table.rule: 在一段期限之內完成，後面接時間長度
在某時間點之前完成，後面接時間點
動作持續到某時間點，常搭配 stay、remain、wait
從過去某時間起延續到現在，主句用現在完成式
後面接一段時間長度，表示持續多久
固定搭配：be responsible for + 名詞或 V-ing

examples: The accounting office will process the invoice within five days.
The vendor must deliver the samples by next Monday.
story: A client in Taichung ordered 200 office chairs on Monday.
The supplier promised delivery within ten business days.
The purchasing team must approve the payment by Thursday.
Mr. Lin has been responsible for this account since last year.

drills.prompt: Can the team approve the payment on Friday?
drills.fix: by Thursday 是最晚在週四之前，週五已經超過期限。

drills.prompt: The supplier will ship the chairs ___ ten days.
drills.fix: 後面接一段時間長度，表示在期限之內完成，用 within。

drills.prompt: Mr. Lin has managed the account ___ last year.
drills.fix: 現在完成式搭配過去的起點 last year，用 since。
